brief:
Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu has issued a stark choice to voters ahead of elections, Al Jazeera English reported. The ultimatum frames the poll as a binary decision between Netanyahu's leadership and Palestinian statehood, according to the outlet.

The statement appears designed to consolidate support among Israeli voters by presenting his candidacy as existential to Israel's position on the Palestinian issue. Netanyahu has consistently opposed Palestinian state establishment as a central policy position.
dek: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu has given voters an election ultimatum: Vote for him or vote for Palestine.
title: Netanyahu tells voters to choose between him and Palestine
